name: Dimension Door
description:
You teleport yourself from your current location to another location within 500 ft of you that you can see or describe. Any objects you're wearing or carrying are transported with you. Roll Lore to determine any additional effects. If the destination is a location you cannot see, the roll is ill-favored.

Describe how you teleport.
successes:
✨: You get a momentary, silent vision of the destination as you cast the spell. You may choose to abort the spell, regaining half of its MP cost if you do.

🌞: After you teleport, for the next minute, you may spend an action to teleport back to your original location.

💀: You miscalculate and arrive in a space already occupied by an object or creature. You and any creature traveling with you each take 4d6 damage, are returned to your original location, and are knocked prone. You each check a Condition.

improvements.name: Take My Hand
improvements.description: When you cast the spell, you may spend 1 additional MP to transport a creature you touch along with you. You may do this for a total of two creatures - one for each hand.
